attributes.name: BRAWN
attributes.meaning: Use brawn for all actions that require physical effort.

skills.name: Endure
skills.meaning: Handle pain, keep going despite exhaustion, hold your liquor.

skills.name: Fight
skills.meaning: Fight enemies bare handed or in close quarters.

skills.name: Force
skills.meaning: Hoist, push, pull, or break things.

skills.name: Stunt
skills.meaning: Jump or run recklessly, dodge bullets.

attributes.name: NERVES
attributes.meaning: You need nerves of steel for actions that require quick reflexes and steady hands.

skills.name: Cool
skills.meaning: Keep your cool, hold still, or show courage.

skills.name: Drive
skills.meaning: Drive a car or bike, pilot a plane.

skills.name: Shoot
skills.meaning: Shoot with pistols and rifles, throw objects with precision.

skills.name: Survival
skills.meaning: Find your bearings in the wilds, improvise weapons or shelter, hunt your dinner.

attributes.name: SMOOTH
attributes.meaning: Show off how smooth you are whenever you have to interact with other people or want to manipulate them.

skills.name: Flirt
skills.meaning: Seduce someone or use your charm.

skills.name: Leadership
skills.meaning: Inspire, give orders, or intimidate people.

skills.name: Speech
skills.meaning: Persuade or deceive someone, or carry out negotiations.

skills.name: Style
skills.meaning: Show style and elegance, clean up nice, or prove your artistic talent.

attributes.name: FOCUS
attributes.meaning: You’ll need focus to concentrate, to notice details, and to recall memories and knowledge.

skills.name: Detect
skills.meaning: Find clues and intel, notice details, sniff out lies.

skills.name: Heal
skills.meaning: Give first aid or comfort someone.

skills.name: Fix
skills.meaning: Repair a mechanism or vehicle, deactivate a trap.

skills.name: Know
skills.meaning: Remember information you learned, recall details and other useful knowledge.

attributes.name: CRIME
attributes.meaning: Your aptitude for crime will come in handy when acting in secret or to notice incoming threats.

skills.name: Awareness
skills.meaning: Keep your eyes and ears open, notice incoming threats.

skills.name: Dexterity
skills.meaning: Perform sleight of hand, steal something, pick a lock.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.meaning: Hide, sneak, or move quietly.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.meaning: Interact with criminals, recall information useful for moving in seedy neighborhoods or dealing with organized crime.

feats.name: ARCHEOLOGY
feats.body: _You know history and the myths that surround it like the back of your hand._ Gain a Free Re-roll for all rolls regarding archeology, dead languages, or the history, culture, and legends of ancient civilizations.

feats.name: ARTIST
feats.body: _Popular or misunderstood, you’re still an artist. The world is your stage._ Choose an art form (e.g.: dancing, singing, painting, etc.) Gain a Free Re-roll for all rolls regarding your chosen art form.

feats.name: BIG AND STRONG
feats.body: _You’re unbelievably tall, large, and bulky._ Your considerable size grants you Help whenever you try to lift or break objects, but it poses a Hindrance when you try to hide in small spaces or balance your mass in unsteady situations.

feats.name: BODYGUARD
feats.body:
_You step in at the last second to help your friend, disregarding your own safety and health._ 

After another Adventurer fails a roll, you suffer the consequences of their failure (for example, if your friend should lose Grit or suffer a Condition, you lose Grit or suffer the Condition in their stead).

feats.name: CHIN UP
feats.body: _Even in the darkest times, your friends can always rely on you._ **[Full Turn]** Remove the Scared or Like a Fool Condition, or another emotional Condition from an ally. Alternatively, while at Camp, you can take the Cheer Up action without needing to roll the dice.

feats.name: DISGUISE
feats.body:
_In the bag, you see an officer’s uniform. And it’s in your size._ 

**[Full Turn]** Find, steal, or craft the perfect disguise for yourself and/or one other Adventurer without rolling the dice.

feats.name: ESTIMATE
feats.body: _Every object you see and handle tells you a story, and whispers to you its price._ Gain a Free Re-roll when evaluating or dating precious items, jewels, and ancient artifacts, and when recognizing fakes.

feats.name: EXPLORER
feats.body:
_There is no obstacle you can’t overcome._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when climbing, swimming, or traveling in wild environments.

feats.name: EYE FOR DETAILS
feats.body: _You notice or remember details that elude everyone else._ **[Quick Action]** You either come up with a detail that can prove helpful in a difficult situation (for example, a loophole or a hidden passage), or ask the Director for a clue or suggestion.

feats.name: FAST REFLEXES
feats.body:
_You’re always alert, ready, and quick._ 

React against an Enemy by rolling Brawn+Stunt instead of the requested Skill. You ignore all -1s from Conditions and circumstances.

feats.name: FAVORED WEAPON
feats.body:
_Your weapon is an extension of your arm, and it never fails you._ 

Choose a melee weapon (e.g. saber, whip, boomerang, etc.). Gain a Free Re-roll when using, repairing, evaluating, or handling the chosen weapon.

feats.name: FIGHTER
feats.body:
_Your fists don't go unnoticed._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll for all Action and Reaction Rolls made when fighting with your hands against human enemies.

feats.name: FIX-IT
feats.body:
_If anyone can fix it, it’s you!_ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when repairing rides or disarming traps.

feats.name: GET DOWN!
feats.body: _You grab your friend and drag them away from danger one second before disaster._ **[Full Turn]** You and another Adventurer quickly hide, dodge a hail of bullets, or avoid being run over without needing to roll the dice.

feats.name: GUIDE
feats.body: _You always know where you are and where you’re going._ Gain a Free Re-roll whenever you’re finding your bearings, following tracks, locating food, or searching for your friends.

feats.name: GUNSLINGER
feats.body:
_The gun is an extension of your arm._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when using, repairing, evaluating, or handling a pistol or revolver.

feats.name: HARDENED
feats.body: _You are afraid of nothing and nobody._ Gain a Free Re-roll when intimidating others or resisting fear.

feats.name: HAWKEYE
feats.body:
_Your aim never misses._ 

Choose between hunting rifle or bow. Gain a Free Re-roll when using, repairing, evaluating, or handling that weapon. 

You can spend 1 Luck to repeat an Action Roll made to shoot with your chosen weapon. You must keep the new result.

feats.name: HEARTBREAKER
feats.body:
_Nobody can resist your damned smile._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when seducing or making a good impression on others.

feats.name: I MEANT TO DO THAT!
feats.body: _You stumble, grab onto a lever, and open a secret passage._ After you fail a Reaction Roll that was not caused by an Enemy, you can immediately generate a lucky turn of events or an unexpected opportunity.

feats.name: LINGUIST
feats.body:
_When you need it, you remember that you studied that language in college, or that you can understand the basics of an unknown dialect._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll to all rolls made to understand or try to speak an unknown language. 

You can spend 1 Luck to become fluent in that language until the end of the Session, without needing to make additional rolls.

feats.name: LOCKPICKER
feats.body: _Doors, safes, and vaults stand no chance against your surgically precise methods._ Gain a Free Re-roll when trying to pick any lock, door, or closed container.

feats.name: MAVERICK
feats.body: _You do things your own way and march to your own tune._ Gain a Free Re-roll to all Action Rolls that clearly and openly go against the choices and directions of the rest of the group.

feats.name: MONEYBAGS
feats.body:
_You inherited a fortune, or started at rock bottom and built a fortune for yourself._ 

You start the game with 4 Cash. **[Full Turn]** You can spend 1 Luck to find a contact, passage to somewhere, an invite to an event, or another service thanks to your huge wealth or fame.

feats.name: PHYSICIAN
feats.body:
_You’re a nurse, medical doctor, or army medic. You’re certainly not squeamish about blood._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll for all rolls made to find a diagnosis, to operate on someone, or to remove physical Conditions such as the Hurt Condition.

feats.name: PILOT
feats.body:
_You feel truly at peace only when you’re above the clouds._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when piloting, repairing, or evaluating flying rides.

feats.name: QUICK AND NIMBLE
feats.body: _You are lithe, thin, or especially slight._ Your slender frame grants you Help whenever you try to hide, sneak, or balance, but it poses a Hindrance when you try to lift or break objects.

feats.name: QUICK FINGERS
feats.body:
_If you want something, you just need to get your hands on it._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when using sleight of hand. **[Full Turn]** You can spend 1 Luck to immediately retrieve a small item you lost during this Session, or to ensure a small object goes unnoticed during a search or check.

feats.name: REASSURE
feats.body: _You lock eyes with your friend, and let them know you believe in them._ Grant +1 to another Adventurer who is about to roll 4 dice or fewer, or allow a friend who has filled in their Bad Box to avoid suffering a Condition.

feats.name: SADDLE UP
feats.body:
_You grab your friend and start running without looking back._ 

**[Quick Action]** You and one other Adventurer skip the next Reaction Turn while running.

feats.name: SAILOR
feats.body:
_You have salt water in your veins._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when driving, repairing, or evaluating a nautical ride.

feats.name: SENSIBLE PACKER
feats.body:
_Not even you know what’s in your backpack, but you're sure that there’s something useful._ 

Your Bag and Backpack never become a Hindrance to you, regardless of the circumstances. 

**[Quick Action]** So long as you are carrying your Bag or Backpack, you can spend 1 Luck to find a tool or weapon in it. The item found can’t be worth more than 2$, is not in sellable condition, and becomes unserviceable after the end of this Scene.

feats.name: SILVER TONGUE
feats.body:
_Your words speak louder than actions, and you certainly know how to talk your way out of trouble._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll for all rolls made to lie, to persuade others, to find a compromise, or to bargain.

feats.name: SKULKER
feats.body:
_Your prey stands no chance._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when hiding or sneaking in wild environments. Additionally, you ignore all drawbacks from Partial Cover when you’re in the wilds.

feats.name: SPECIALIST
feats.body:
_No worry: this is your specialty._ 

Choose one technical specialty (e.g.: demolition, radio, excavation, etc.). Gain a Free Re-roll for all rolls regarding your chosen specialty.

feats.name: SUBTERFUGE
feats.body: _What the others don’t know can’t hurt them. And most importantly, it can't hurt you._ Gain a Free Re-roll when lying, deceiving, or cheating.

feats.name: TEAMWORK
feats.body: _Someone distracts them, and you strike. That’s what I call teamwork!_ **[Full Turn]** After another Adventurer gave you an Assist this Turn, you can spend 1 Luck to gain an automatic success without rolling the dice.

feats.name: THAT WAS CLOSE!
feats.body: _Thanks to your instincts or to a stroke of luck, you move away before it’s too late._ Repeat one Reaction Roll of any kind. Ignore all -1s from Conditions and circumstances. You must keep the new result.

feats.name: THRILL SEEKER
feats.body:
_When things get serious, just get out of the line of fire._ 

Gain a Free Re-roll when dodging bullets, arrows, or triggered traps, and for all rolls to get out of the way and find cover.

feats.name: TOO YOUNG TO DIE
feats.body:
_You’re young and carefree. You feel like nothing can stop you._ When filling in the Bad Box, you suffer no Condition. 

You can only gain this Feat when creating a Young Adventurer. You cannot choose this Feat while Advancing.

feats.name: TRAILBLAZER
feats.body:
_Where others see obstacles, you find a path._ 

**[Full Turn]** Create a safe path, an alternative route, some space, or an opening thanks to your technical or natural knowledge.

feats.name: WATCH AND LEARN
feats.body:
_If they can do it, so can you._ 

After another Adventurer succeeds in an Action Roll this Turn, you automatically succeed in the same action without rolling the dice.

gearFeats.ACCURATE: This weapon is especially precise. You can spend one Turn to take aim at a target. On your next Turn, you gain +1 to your roll to hit that target.
gearFeats.SINGLE SHOT: The gun doesn’t use a Mag but single munitions. Ignore Mags and keep track of munitions in your equipment.
gearFeats.SILENT: The weapon is very quiet. When shooting, you don’t alert the enemy and don’t reveal your position.
gearFeats.RAPID FIRE: When laying down Covering Fire you also gain +1 to your next Reaction Roll.
gearFeats.SLOW RELOAD: The weapon requires a longer time to be reloaded. You need a Full Action instead of a Quick Action in order to reload the gun.
gearFeats.UNCOMMON: The weapon or gear is hard to come by. The Director is tasked with determining if and how you can find or craft the item you are looking for and what the price will be, based on the circumstances.
gearFeats.IMPACT: The weapon grants Help to crash through doors and objects and to hurl Enemies away.
gearFeats.MELEE WEAPON: If you are not trained with them, melee weapons grant you no special advantage, but they are essential if you have the Favored Weapon Feat.
gearFeats.BULKY: The weapon or piece of gear is especially big or heavy, it poses a Hindrance when you need to move quickly, climb, or swim.
gearFeats.FIXED: The weapon is fixed on the ground or on a ride, it cannot be moved or carried. Fixed weapons have no mags and can keep shooting until they are destroyed.
gearFeats.SHARP: The weapon grants Help to cut ropes, carve wooden objects, and to cut through the vegetation.
gearFeats.BOOM!:
The weapon has powerful explosive blasts, it grants Help to crash through obstacles, gates, rides, or walls. 

Enemies who sustain a hit from a weapon with this Feat always lose 1 additional Grit, but Adventurers nearby will also run the risk of becoming Hurt.

Elegant Clothes.name: Elegant Clothes
Elegant Clothes.detail: Grant Help for stylish occasions but are a Hindrance to movements.

Lockpicking Set.name: Lockpicking Set
Lockpicking Set.detail: Grants Help to pick locks and disarm traps.

Tool-bag.name: Tool-bag
Tool-bag.detail: Grants Help to repair objects or rides.

Grappling Hook.name: Grappling Hook
Grappling Hook.detail: Grants Help to climb and swing.

Compass.name: Compass
Compass.detail: Grants Help to find your bearings or magnetic North.

Winter Clothes.name: Winter Clothes
Winter Clothes.detail: Grant Help to withstand cold or bad weather.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.detail: Grants Help to see in the dark but is a Hindrance when hiding.

Climbing Gear.name: Climbing Gear
Climbing Gear.detail: Grants Help when climbing walls made of rock or ice.

Camping Cookware.name: Camping Cookware
Camping Cookware.detail: Grants Help to cook in a Camp.

Musical Instrument.name: Musical Instrument
Musical Instrument.detail: Allows you to play and perform.

Old Ride.name: Old Ride
Old Ride.detail: An old plane, ship, or jeep.

Lighter.name: Lighter
Lighter.detail: Grants Help to light a fire.

Radio.name: Radio
Radio.detail: Allows you to communicate at a distance.

Hunting Bow.name: Hunting Bow
Hunting Bow.detail: Allows you to shoot arrows with +1.

Whip.name: Whip
Whip.detail: Can be used to grab distant items.

Projectiles.name: Projectiles
Projectiles.detail: 10 arrows for a bow or 1 rocket for a rocket launcher.

Mags (2).name: Mags (2)
Mags (2).detail: 2 Mags for a type of weapon of your choice.
